lane: مُسَرْهَدٌ A _fat_ camel's hump: (S, L, K:) or a camel's hump _cut in pieces._ (L.) === _Supplied with the comforts and conveniences of life,_ and _well fed:_ and, with ة, a woman _fat, and well fed._ (L.) [Applied also to a young camel: see an ex. in a hemistich cited in the first paragraph of art. رجل.]
